## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.3 is a stable servicing release that records the end of the Chrome M151 release line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Chrome M151 branch retirement recorded** — Closes the M151 release line after the upstream Chrome branch retired, keeping the bundled Skia engine's release tracking current. ([#5089](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5089))
